question: What does the term 'e-commerce' refer to?

options.text: Buying and selling of goods and services over the internet

solution:
The correct answer is __**Buying and selling of goods and services over the internet**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **E-commerce** refers to the buying and selling of goods and services over the internet.
 
• It encompasses a wide range of online business activities for products and services.
 
• E-commerce allows consumers to electronically exchange goods and services with no barriers of time or distance.
 
• The convenience of e-commerce makes it a popular choice among consumers and businesses alike.
 
• Examples of e-commerce platforms include Amazon, eBay, and Alibaba.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **E-commerce** has significantly grown over the past few decades due to the increase in internet usage and technological advancements.
 
• It offers several advantages such as a wide range of products, competitive pricing, and the convenience of shopping from home.
 
• There are different types of e-commerce models including B2B (Business to Business), B2C (Business to Consumer), C2C (Consumer to Consumer), and C2B (Consumer to Business).
 
• Security and privacy are critical aspects of e-commerce, and businesses invest significantly in technology to protect their customers' information.
 
• The rise of mobile commerce (m-commerce) is a significant trend where consumers use their smartphones and tablets to conduct online transactions.
